## Activity

During June 2021, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 281 captures. Activity was delivered through the clinic’s scheduled session lists, which ran as planned apart from routine leave. The capture total records the activity completed during the reporting month and provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures below.

## Image quality

There were 12 ungradable captures during the month. The ungradable rate was 4.3 per cent. This result indicates that most captures were of sufficient quality for assessment, while the ungradable images remain relevant to ongoing review of capture practice and service processes.

## Grading

Grading identified 44 referable results. The median lag from photograph to grade was 1 day. This records the central turnaround time for grading and indicates that the service maintained a short interval between image capture and the grading outcome. The referable results should continue through the applicable follow-up pathway.
